dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,1)>Why, hello there! I sensed a visitor, but I wasn’t expecting
one as adorable as you.

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,27)><$facial(4,13)>Oh? You’re building towns with the help of other Pokémon
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,1)>in the hope that humans may return someday?
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,668)><$facial(4,4)>What a wonderful sentiment.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>You’ll find this island is filled with furniture and other
items left behind by humans.
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,4)>Feel free to take them—they might be of use to you.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>You know... I sense something within you. A strange,
mystical power.

<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)>Actually, would you mind accompanying me for a while?
<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,805)>I’d like to show you an interesting spot on this island.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>I have a feeling you may find it useful. It’s right this way.

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>There’s a spot on this island that caught my eye.
Follow me, little one.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>There’s a cave beneath this building that has piqued my
interest. <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,805)>I sense a powerful aura coming from deep within.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,663)><$facial(4,9)>I’ve been hesitant to venture in by myself. Would you be
willing to explore it with me?
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,668)><$facial(4,4)>Why thank you! Let’s be off, then.
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,668)><$facial(4,4)>Why thank you! Let’s be off, then.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>When I spotted this cave earlier, I was unable to get past
the entrance due to flooding.
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>If that is still the case, first we’ll need to block off the
source of the water...
<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>Let’s venture into the cave, shall we?

<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Though if the entrance is still flooded, we’ll need to block
off the water source first...

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Look, <$cdef(27)>! I’m certain those ore
deposits
are
the
source
of
the
powerful
aura
I sense.

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>So that aura was coming from this <$cdef(27)><$ifull(123)>?
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>This ore is quite rare, you know.
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,668)>Thank you for joining me on this adventure and indulging
my curiosity, <$cdef(27)>.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,663)>If you take some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(123)> with you,
I’m certain you’ll find a use for them.

<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,827)><$facial(4,9)>Though deposits of this ore are known to be quite hard...
I doubt you’d manage to smash them with ease.
<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,7)>There must be some way to extract it, surely?<$motion(4,654)>

Don’t forget that you can power up <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)> by
eating <$cdef(27)>hamburger steak!
As for how to make <$cdef(27)>hamburger steak... Sizzle, sizzle it in a
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1304)>! ♪

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,665)><$facial(4,13)>What’s this? You want to eat <$cdef(27)>hamburger steak? What an
unexpected response.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,805)>Now that you mention it, I’m quite sure I smelled
<$cdef(27)>hamburger steak in this area earlier... <$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)>Or did I
imagine it?

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,53)>Actually, I have something really neat! Here, I’ll give it
to you!
You got <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(21)></color> and <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(60)></color>!
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)><$cdef(27)><fcap><fqty(2)><$ifull(21)></color> are so yummy! I just LOVE <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(21)></color>!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Didja know you can use <$cdef(27)><$ifull(21)> to make <$cdef(27)>hamburger
steak? It’s called <$cdef(27)><$ifull(39)>, and it’ll
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,50)>give you SO much energy!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,827)>Ideally, you would be able to smash the ore deposits and
collect <$cdef(27)><$ifull(123)> from them.
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,7)>Unfortunately, it won’t be easy, given how hard they are...<$motion(4,654)>

You can power up <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)> by eating
<$cdef(27)>hamburger steak!
As for how to make <$cdef(27)>hamburger steak... Sizzle, sizzle it in a
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1304)>! ♪

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,665)><$facial(4,4)>Look at you! I should have known you’d have no trouble
getting your hands on some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(123)>.
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,668)><$voicel(4,10)>You continue to amaze me, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>If you melt those in a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)> to make <$cdef(27)>ingots,
you should be able to craft all kinds of tools and items.
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,668)><$facial(4,4)>I’m so pleased I was able to help you. ♪
